dot.name: DoT
dot.description: Deals damage each tick, before normal spells (including effects just applied by an Instant). Loses 1 stack each tick. Reapplying adds duration, not per-tick power.

hot.name: HoT
hot.description: Heals each tick, before normal spells (including effects just applied by an Instant). Loses 1 stack each tick. Reapplying adds duration, not per-tick power.

instant.name: Instant
instant.description: Resolves at tick start, before damage over time and duration countdowns. Your next spell waits until the next tick.

crit.name: Crit
crit.description: A critical hit deals 150% of normal damage.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: X is the number of identical Channel cards in a consecutive group in your hand. Each copy casts separately at its listed time and mana cost. Groups do not wrap across the ends of the hand.

unique.name: Unique
unique.description: Special restriction. Copy, cast, and stacking limits: TBD.

moonfire.name: Moonfire
moonfire.description: A DoT that deals 10 damage per tick.

sunfire.name: Sunfire
sunfire.description: A DoT that deals 20 damage per tick.

lifebloom.name: Lifebloom
lifebloom.description: Heals 10 × X health per tick. X: TBD.

growth.name: Growth
growth.description: A HoT that heals 10 health per tick.

slowness.name: Slowness
slowness.description: The next spell takes 1 extra tick to cast.

starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.description: A DoT that deals 50 damage per tick.

trap.name: Trap
trap.description: Deals 10 × the number of spells cast while trapped. Trigger timing: TBD.

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.description: Wild Growth changes Growth healing to 3 per tick. Other effects: TBD.

tide.name: Tide
tide.description: Grants a 20% chance to trigger Tidecaller.

tidecaller.name: Tidecaller
tidecaller.description: When triggered, the spell resolves twice.

steal.name: Steal
steal.description: Take mana from the opponent and gain it yourself.

veil.name: Veil
veil.description: Spells deal 50% less damage and grant 5 mana per spell.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: Immune to all damage while active. Each stack adds 1 tick of duration; taking damage does not consume stacks.

hotstreak.name: Hotstreak
hotstreak.description: Each stack grants 10% crit chance (up to 100%) and loses 1 stack per tick. Crossing from below 5 to at least 5 stacks grants 3 Combust. Hotstreak is not consumed.

combust.name: Combust
combust.description: While active, spells take at most 1 tick; Instant stays Instant. Each completed spell deals 5 damage to you. Each stack adds 1 tick of duration.

burn.name: Burn
burn.description: A DoT that deals X damage per tick. X: TBD.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.description: While active, your critical hits deal 200% of normal damage instead of 150%. Each stack adds 1 tick of duration.

interrupt.name: Interrupt
interrupt.description: Stops the opponent’s current cast or channel.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description: On death while active, revive with half maximum health and mana. Each stack adds 1 tick of duration. Rebirth does not consume the remaining duration.
